title: FeedMessage
description: One message on the event feed. `kind` says which payload field is set. `match_start` comes first when a subscriber syncs and whenever a new match is loaded; then the match's events in offset order; then `match_end` after the last one.

head.description: On `match_start`: how many events had been published when the subscriber synced. Events below this offset are a catch-up on what already happened, so consumers rebuild state from them without acting on them.
